main.description: Delete the group: its account, its repo and its spaces on this host, and the host's own state about it. Irreversible. Requires group.configure, or, for a deactivated group, having held it when the group was switched off. Records members wrote into its spaces live on their own PDSes and are not touched. If no steward holds a recovery key, the group's did:plc is tombstoned too, since nobody could ever use it again; with one, the DID is left for its holders.

group.description: The group DID. Every method is served by the group's host and authorized against that group's roles.

tombstoned.description: Whether the group's DID was ended in the directory.
